titleStmt.title: Memorandum by the Joint Chiefs of Staff to the Secretary of Defense (Marshall)

div.head: Memorandum by the Joint Chiefs of Staff to the Secretary of Defense (Marshall)
div.p: Subject: Courses of Action Relative to Communist China and Korea.

list.item: The Joint Chiefs of Staff have tentatively agreed upon the following objectives relative to Communist China and Korea together with the actions to be taken to attain them with some indication as to the timing.

list.label: a.
list.item: Maintain the security of the off-shore defense line: Japan—Ryukyus—Philippines.
list.label: b.
list.item: Deny Formosa to the Communists.
list.label: c.
list.item: Delay a general war with Russia until we have achieved the requisite degree of military and industrial mobilization.
list.label: d.
list.item: Prevent, by all appropriate means, the further spread by force of Communism on the mainland of Asia: particularly into Indochina, Siam and Malaya.
list.label: e.
f.
list.item: Support establishment in China of a government friendly to the United States.

list.label: a.
list.item: With the preservation of the combat effectiveness of our forces as an overriding consideration, stabilize the situation in Korea or evacuate to Japan if forced out of Korea.
list.label: b.
list.item:
Limit major U.S. ground forces in the Far East to those now committed, unless: (1)
The outcome of the present Chinese offensive should indicate that we can profitably remain in Korea with the number of U.S. divisions now committed, in which event, if the Army could provide them and at the same time meet our commitments in Europe, not to exceed two partly trained divisions might be deployed to Japan to increase its security.
list.label: c.
list.item: Expedite the build-up of Japanese defense forces.
list.label: d.
list.item: Move troops to Japan from Korea as necessary to defend Japan.
list.label: e.
list.item: Continue and intensify now an economic blockade of trade with China.
list.label: f.
list.item: Prepare now to impose a naval blockade of China and place it into effect as soon as our position in Korea is stabilized, or when we have evacuated Korea, and depending upon circumstances then obtaining.
list.label: g.
list.item: Remove now restrictions on air reconnaissance of China coastal areas and of Manchuria.
list.label: h.
list.item: Remove now the restrictions on operations of the Chinese Nationalist forces and give such logistic support to those forces as will contribute to effective operations against the Communists.
list.label: i.
list.item: Continue to bomb military targets in Korea.
list.label: j.
list.item: Press now for UN action branding Communist China as an aggressor.
list.label: k.
list.item: Send a military training mission and increase MDAP to Chinese Nationalists on Formosa.
list.label: l.
list.item: Furnish now all practicable covert aid to effective Nationalist guerrilla forces in China.
list.label: m.
list.item: Initiate damaging naval and air attacks on objectives in Communist China at such time as the Chinese Communists attack any of our forces outside of Korea.
list.label: n.
list.item: Increase MDAP to Indochina and assist training of Viet Nam forces if requested by French authorities.
list.label: o.
list.item: Consult with Siamese authorities and, if requested, furnish a military mission and increase MDAP aid to Siam.
list.label: p.
list.item: Strengthen the Philippines primarily by exerting pressure on the Philippine Government to establish internal security.

closer.signed:
For the Joint Chiefs of Staff:
Omar N. Bradley
